purpose: Actual findings and fixes during development. This log records assistant work; it is not a claim that the repository owner discovered or fixed these issues.

findings.title: Image processing dependency was behind its security fixes
findings.foundBy: Assistant running npm audit after the first install
findings.cause: The initial Sharp version range stayed on 0.34, which excluded newer fixes in its image decoding libraries.
findings.change: Updated Sharp to 0.35.5 before adding the upload pipeline.
findings.verification: npm install completed with zero reported vulnerabilities.
findings.discussion: Explain why a dependency range can prevent a security update, and how decoding untrusted image files changes the importance of the dependency.

findings.title: Saved profile names reverted to cached values
findings.cause: The form reset effect ran when isDirty changed after a save, while its props still held an older snapshot.
findings.change: Reset from upstream data only when actual server values change.
findings.verification: tests/auth/profile-settings.test.tsx checks saving without reverting the edited name.

findings.title: The plan overlay did not contain keyboard focus
findings.foundBy: Assistant reviewing the plan form markup
findings.cause: A positioned region looked like a dialog but did not provide browser modal behavior.
findings.change: Use a native dialog, preserve Escape handling, and restore focus when it closes.
findings.verification: tests/plans/dialog.test.tsx plus browser verification at 390px: focus stayed inside the modal and Escape returned focus to New plan.
